subject: Civil Engineering
title: Concrete Repair and Rehabilitation
description: A fast breakdown of Concrete Repair and Rehabilitation for builders.

hook.text: A 50-year-old bridge deck is spalling. Tear it down or repair it? Repair saves millions.

buildup.text: Patch repairs remove damaged concrete and replace it with new material — bonded to the old.

discovery.text: Cathodic protection sends electric current through the rebar — stopping corrosion in its tracks.

twist.text: Carbon fiber wraps strengthen deficient members without adding significant weight.

climax.text: Electrochemical chloride extraction pulls salt ions out of contaminated concrete — non-destructive.

punchline.text: Repair extends life by decades. Replacement is the last resort, not the first.

quiz.question: How does cathodic protection stop rebar corrosion?
options: It coats the rebar with a layer of protective paint
Electric current reverses the corrosion process, preventing rust formation
It heats the concrete to dry out moisture around the steel
